adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, rss.items.each calls TopicEmbed.import per feed item. TopicEmbed.import does TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first for each item, which is one SELECT per item, and in the update path it also does embed.post (a separate query unless the association is already loaded). This is a verifiable per-item query pattern from the diff and is a performance/scalability concern rather than a correctness defect. The referenced TopicEmbed.where(...).exists? calls in TopicRetriever are real but are per retrieve invocation, not per feed item.
